clusters.name: After your sister Bea was born, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around the time your sister Bea was born in March 1995, several things piled up over the next year and a half: your mother felt worn out and on edge, your father was working late and rarely home, you had stomach aches and missed school, your father and Jonah had shouting matches, and your mother did not go back to her job.
clusters.change: You already had this run grouped together; the change here is naming it by the birth that sits at the start of it rather than by any one person's trouble, since the shifts touch your mother, your father, you, and Jonah within the same year and a half.
